head: Radarvar speed camera app warns of cameras, works offline and in CarPlay
dek: Radarvar is a new iPhone app that warns you ahead of speed cameras, red-light cameras and average speed zones and tells you the speed limit of the road you're on. It costs 12.99 dollars once and was #90 among paid Navigation apps on the US App Store on 13 November.
details: The listing covers 17 countries, including the US, the UK, Germany and Australia, with more than 25,000 fixed cameras from OpenStreetMap and official open data; the data is kept on the phone, so alerts work without a connection. It speaks alerts in the background, shows cameras and the limit in CarPlay, offers turn-by-turn navigation built on Apple Maps and lets drivers report speed traps and hazards anonymously. There's no subscription and no in-app purchase. It's made by Ali Can, and it isn't a radar detector.
means: If you want camera and speed limit warnings without a monthly fee, this is a one-time purchase that keeps working offline.
todo: Check that camera warning apps are allowed where you drive before using one, and remember the listing says coverage depends on public data in each region.
